# Fixed Select references

Read-only originals from shadcn/ui `8ab27715521cbd4f87ae6886cd989cbb678f6de7`, Base wrappers and Vega utilities. `manifest.json` records official Git blob IDs, SHA256 and raw origins. Every raw blob was verified against the non-truncated official recursive tree before copying.

The Base UI `@base-ui/react@1.6.0` members were extracted byte-for-byte from the official npm tarball after verifying its published SHA512 integrity. The manifest records each member hash and tarball SHA256. Its MIT license and package metadata are included. These are reference inputs; no React or npm runtime is shipped or executed by the Go widget.

The standalone example imports name `base-nova`; component behavior comes from the same Base wrapper, while Go appearance follows the separately pinned Vega utilities. This archive does not claim all style profiles or generic Base options are implemented. `examples/select-composition/source-coverage.json` is a derived mapping to actual native flows, not upstream text.

Public MyGo Overlay/AttachTo, native button/listbox focus and ScrollState replace DOM portals/focus-manager CSS. String identities plus current-build rich item/value renderers represent the fixed object Plan recipe; callers keep their objects in application state. `UnselectedValue` represents the fixed selectable null option without sacrificing legitimate empty string identities. NativeSelect remains the original OS single-selection menu route; no OS multiple-select menu behavior is invented.
